capabilities: Move a file and all files that link to it to a new folder
Select related files from the file tree or editor context menu
extras: The README says the plugin is not yet published in the community plugin manager; installing via BRAT is currently recommended, and manual installation steps are provided.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to move a note and its related (inlinked) files together, so gathering scattered connected files into one folder must be done one by one.
summary: File-mover that moves a note together with all files that link to it (its inlinks) into a chosen folder via the file or editor context menu.
